items.title: Profinite spaces are exactly the Hausdorff quasi-compact totally disconnected spaces, and are cofiltered limits of finite discrete spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes profinite spaces as Hausdorff quasi-compact totally disconnected spaces and adds that such a space is a cofiltered limit of finite discrete spaces (author lemma at source lines 4350-4360, label lemma-profinite). The proof (source lines 4362-4396) proves quasi-compactness, Hausdorffness and total disconnectedness from a limit description, and conversely builds the inverse system of finite clopen decompositions and shows that the canonical map into its limit is bijective and hence a homeomorphism (proof lines 4362-4395). The construction of the system of decompositions and the bijectivity argument are the substance. H3.
